title: Cops RESCUE Two Little Kids From a Terrifying House Of Horrors
description:
On June 12th, 2024. Police responded to a call regarding a highly intoxicated father who was punching his own toddlers for no apparent reason. The mom stated that she was taking them to a basketball game and went to drop off stuff in the car, and she was alerted when one of her kids started yelling for help. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
